text:
anna: Quick question — need to open access from Dedicated infra to a private Redis endpoint in prod.
It lives in customer-vpc (10.10.0.0/16) and is an internal redis cluster with TLS. We currently have a VPCE for S3 but not for Redis. Need to know what gating we need for security review and allowlist. Can we allow by SG reference or do we have to add IP ranges to partner allowlist? ping @kevin @tina :wave:

kevin: Prefer SG referencing when possible. If Dedicated nodes live in a different AWS account/tenant, SG refs across accounts/peers are tricky. Are the Dedicated nodes in the same account or peered?

anna: Dedicated is in a separate AWS account (redwood-dedicated-prod) and there is VPC peering today. Nodes autoscale so IPs change. Thinking of either adding NAT with stable EIPs or standing up a small proxy in the Redis VPC. Need a quick go/no-go for a customer cutover this week.

tina: Quick notes: SG references do NOT cross accounts with classic peering, so don't rely on that. Options ranked: 1) Interface VPC Endpoint / PrivateLink 2) NAT Gateway with EIP(s) + allowlist those EIPs 3) proxy (NAT/proxy) in the owning VPC with SG locked down to the proxy's SG. For autoscaling requesters, NAT+EIP or proxy are the practical short-term choices.

anna: For the short-term can we do temp allowlist of NAT EIPs in the redis SG and then migrate to VPCE/PrivateLink later? Also need to confirm logging redaction: we must not log Redis AUTH tokens or plaintext credentials anywhere.

kevin: Temp allowlist is OK with controls: - create a JIRA ticket with owner + expiry - limit duration (e.g., 2 weeks) - require TLS and AUTH on the Redis cluster - secrets MUST be in Secrets Manager with KMS encryption - logging pipeline must drop any fields that look like passwords/tokens (filter by /auth|password|requirepass/i).

anna: Terraform snippet planned for the temp rule (will run in redis owning acct):
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "redis_allow_from_nat" {
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = 6379
  to_port     = 6379
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["54.23.12.100/32", "54.23.12.101/32"]
  description = "temp allowlist for dedicated egress NAT EIPs - expires 2026-07-01"
}
```

kevin: That looks fine for a temporary measure. Add tags: `owner`, `expiry` and `jira`. Also require an IAM role assumption audit: who can modify SG rules.

tina: Also add a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to strip sensitive fields before sending logs downstream. We'll add an automation job to remove the SG rule on expiry.

deploy-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345 — includes terraform change + expiry tag + PR checklist for secrets rotation and jira link placeholder.

kevin: Approve with conditions: create JIRA-SEC-4242 with owner=anna, expiry=2026-07-01, rotate secret within 7 days after expiry (or earlier), enable VPC Flow Logs for the Redis subnet and deliver to secure bucket with lifecycle and access controls. :white_check_mark:

anna: Thanks — will create the Jira now and link the PR. I'll also schedule the follow-up to implement VPCE/PrivateLink as the final solution.

tina: Thanks team — please paste the final PR link here once merged and set a calendar reminder for the expiry. :thumbsup:
